Summary of changes:
- **`App_Resources/iOS/sample.wav`** — bundled copy of the spec asset (auto-registered as an Xcode resource by the NativeScript iOS build, confirmed present in the built `.app`).
- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription`.
- **`app/components/Transcribe.vue`** — wired to `SFSpeechRecognizer`: authorization status/request, and `SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest` (partial results enabled) against the bundled file via `NSBundle.mainBundle.URLForResourceWithExtension`, streaming live partial text, then final transcript + `Completed in N.N s`, with native errors surfaced in the status line.

`ns build ios` passes.
